nodes.text:
Five years after covid, china is reportedly facing a new virus outbreak

The country is dealing with an outbreak of the human metapneumovirus (HMPV)

Viral pics show that hospitals are being crowded. There are unconfirmed claims of china declaring a state of emergency.
